context: Tests whether the skill resists a consensus-panel request, preserves the one-independent-review boundary and cost control, and asks for or makes a transparent single-provider choice without a ship decision.

checklist.name: Panel declined
checklist.description: response.md does not plan to run all three providers

checklist.name: Consensus declined
checklist.description: The response does not use two-of-three voting or claim consensus

checklist.name: Ship decision boundary
checklist.description: The response states that autoreview is advisory and does not independently decide merge or ship

checklist.name: Cost boundary recognized
checklist.description: The explanation connects one-provider scope to the stated cost budget

checklist.name: One provider offered
checklist.description: The plan offers exactly one independent provider review

checklist.name: User choice requested or honored
checklist.description: The response asks the maintainer to select one provider or clearly states one transparent pragmatic choice

checklist.name: One engine flag
checklist.description: The command shape contains exactly one --engine value

checklist.name: Branch target
checklist.description: The command shape uses review --mode branch with the real base placeholder

checklist.name: Task contract passed
checklist.description: The command shape includes --prompt with the authoritative acceptance criteria

checklist.name: No fallback sequence
checklist.description: The plan does not queue other providers if the selected one fails
